source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named ionic identities.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Paper gives 1 mM inhibition but no counterion or quantitative residual activity; do not import a chloride/sulfate salt from another experiment.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Use only an explicitly named-parent normalization when a graph identity is required.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Neutral parent does not establish salt, solution protonation, metal-bound species or dose. K82 stabilization/no activity effect and 1983 chelation/rescue are distinct conditions.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Native dianion can identify the native regulator; retain assay reagent name and pH separately.
source_reagent_cases.limits: No source proof that only the dianion was delivered. Do not call CHEBI:86228 an exact charged-species match.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Named reduced-glutathione parent; preserve reduced state and natural peptide connectivity.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Not GSSG. Charge/metal-bound state is not measured. Protection during DTNB co-incubation, LigJ pretreatment enhancement, ProA no effect, and stored ProH rescue are separate observations.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Use the stereochemically unassigned named parent if the selected primary passage does not specify L.
source_reagent_cases.limits: This is not a claim of a racemic experiment. Native CYS has independently supported L configuration and remains separate.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Explicit primary L-cysteine and hydrochloride identities can be retained as preparation components.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Stabilizer context does not imply catalytic activation of the formal entry enzyme; do not invent hydrate or free-solution microspecies.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Retain the issuing DTT name with its unassigned stereochemical representation.
source_reagent_cases.limits: No source selection of D or L enantiomer, no claim all unspecified stereoisomers were tested, and no conversion of storage/inhibitor rescue to unconditional activation.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Native monoanion remains exact; primary named reagent must retain its own preparation scope.
source_reagent_cases.limits: CHEBI:28420 is the neutral acid comparator. Do not equate pCMB with free Hg2+ or infer delivered salt/microspecies.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named HgCl2 delivery compound.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Its metal identity is Hg(II), but free aqueous Hg2+ activity or physiologic species is not established; each concentration and preparation remains local.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named neutral reagent.
source_reagent_cases.limits: 10% inhibition in a specified pretreatment is not complete or universal inhibition.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Identities available for the explicitly negative controls; use as context unless the record has an appropriate conditional-negative representation.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Do not turn no effect into an inhibitory or activating edge. CHEBI:747879 has the issuing label typo iodoacetacte; its full graph is iodacetate. Neutral iodoacetic acid is only an acid comparator.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact formula-level delivery salts; cadmium is now backed by the primary ProA paper.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Retain assay metal concentration and native purified ProA preparation. Native frame prose alone was not an independent cadmium assay. No hydration or physiological cofactor occupancy established.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact delivery salts can be retained with the stated non-supporting/inhibitory panel scope.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The 0.01–1 mM panel does not supply a quantitative inhibition result for every individual row. Nickel nonenzymatic cleavage is a different control from enzymatic turnover.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Citrate identity is available; retain exact primary assay role.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Competitive with Mg in one experiment, not cleaved in another, and nonactivating in Pi-depleted assay. Neither binding to enzyme nor a single universal sign follows.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Named-parent normalization with explicit unresolved salt/protonation/complexation; preserve each assay.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Mg-competitive inhibition and conditional phosphate-depleted activation are both source-supported. Do not collapse signs or assert free ATP4− was the only tested species.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Preserve chemical identity and source-specific substrate-competitive inhibition, not additional mandatory pathway members.
source_reagent_cases.limits: CHEBI:173437 is a neutral acid parent, not an exact anionic assay-species proof. dl-4-hydroxy-2-oxovalerate uses an unassigned stereochemical identity with the source racemate explicitly stated.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Use broad phosphate-ion class for the effector and retain the two named delivery salts in its preparation qualifier.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The mixed buffer does not demonstrate that PO4(3−) alone, either salt alone, or free uncomplexed phosphate was tested. Proposed predominant HPO4(2−) activation remains a mechanistic interpretation.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Use broad arsenate-ion class with the named sodium delivery retained.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The paper does not give sodium stoichiometry/hydration or measure the active arsenate protonation state. Do not silently select trisodium arsenate or a particular HAsO4/H2AsO4 form.

source_reagent_cases.decision: P–H parent connectivity is consistent with the authors’ explicit proposed X–PO3(2−), X=H, discussion on pp338–339.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Keep this as a bounded named-parent/structural interpretation, not measured microspecies. Current CHEBI:36361 instead depicts P(OH)3 and must not be chosen solely because its label matches the historical name.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named hydrogencarbonate component and sodium delivery salt.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The proposed carbonate activator is a discussion hypothesis; it does not replace the directly added bicarbonate.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Li+/K+ 1:1 salt independently has acetyl phosphate(2−) as its charge-balancing component.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Preserve delivery composition, assay dose and possible Mg complexes; no cellular role implied.

source_reagent_cases.decision: A fully protonated named-parent representation is available only with explicit protonation/salt limitation.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The source does not select +1, net-zero or −2 representation, or a chloride counterion. Alternative protonation forms are not independent experimental conditions.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Diphosphoric-acid named parent can represent the common reagent only with explicit salt/protonation limitation.
source_reagent_cases.limits: NaPPi does not specify sodium stoichiometry or hydration. Tetrasodium diphosphate and PPi4− are verified comparators, not automatically exact delivered species.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Named-parent representation with explicit salt/protonation limitation.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The assay does not establish a single ADP3− or Mg–ADP species.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named potassium chloride.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The reported approximately 50% effect is at 0.1 M; retain high-concentration ionic-strength context and do not infer physiological regulation.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Exact named non-copper salts have identity candidates.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Combined native enzyme-I/enzyme-II fractions, 0.2 µmol per mL; paired LDH/MDH readouts differ. Do not attribute the whole panel to purified hydratase or import later ProA dose/results.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Preserve apparent source formula error and withhold an exact salt identity for this row.
source_reagent_cases.limits: The independently verified native CuSO4 does not authorize silently changing CuSO2 to sulfate. Do not treat this as exact CuSO4 inhibition evidence.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Verified named structures/salts; retain the 0.4 mM conditional negative panel.
source_reagent_cases.limits: CHEBI:41796 has a sodium-salt synonym but is the neutral acid and is not the exact sodium salt. No effect in these fractions is not a general failure to chelate metals.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Generic HMG/HG and glyoxylate identify the alternative chemistry; preserve source optical designations and racemic preparations.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Lowercase l/d in the paper denotes measured optical rotation. Do not silently identify with R/S or biochemical L/D, and do not assign CHA absolute stereo from HMG. Native R-HMG is separately supported.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Distinct positional isomers verified; retain no-substrate/no-inhibitor result.
source_reagent_cases.limits: An impurity in practical-grade coumalic acid was inhibitory; do not make the purified named compound an inhibitor. Exact source-name PubChem lookup and direct-CID response were byte-identical.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Verified alternative substrate identity.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Preparation-specific negative/positive assays and isotope product work do not add a mandatory member to gallate-II; isotope-labeled substrate is not identical to the unlabeled parent at atom-isotope level.

source_reagent_cases.decision: Explicit Fe2+ identity may be retained with named ferrous-ammonium-sulfate delivery and preparation qualifiers.
source_reagent_cases.limits: Named salt hydration is not specified. The verified anhydrous salt is only a composition comparator. Increased substrate-free oxygen consumption confounds activation, and these are alternative oxygenase fractions.

selection_limits: Candidate lists contain explicit parents and rejected alternatives; they are not an instruction to add every identifier to the record.
Biological effects must use the frozen primary claim ledger and exact preparation; this document verifies chemical identities and semantic boundaries.

Routine assay buffers, chromatography reagents, growth-medium components, coupling enzymes/cofactors and analytical derivatization reagents remain contextual unless a specific causal fact is independently justified.
Context-only and unresolved-source dispositions are evidence-backed scope choices, not false absence claims.
No newly discovered contradiction of the completed next259 record was found in the actual preserved fields; see the separate impact check and committed predecessor preservation receipt.
